redaction_policy.description: Which entity types the extension removes, and the default site policy. This cannot disable the cloud payload guard.

defaultValue.value: Find sensitive spans in the user text. Reply with JSON only. Copy each text value exactly from the input. Skip placeholders such as [PERSON_1].

on_device_prompt.description: System prompt for on-device detection. Raw text is only sent to ONLY_ON_DEVICE.

defaultValue.value: Draft a short, polite reply to the message. It is already redacted. Use only placeholders that already appear in the message, copied exactly. Do not invent placeholders, names, email addresses, phone numbers, or signatures. Do not sign with a made-up name. If you sign, use the sender's own placeholder from the message, or do not sign at all.

cloud_reply_prompt.description: Cloud prompt for the draft-reply task. The extension sends this with already redacted text.

defaultValue.value: Summarize the message. It is already redacted. Keep every placeholder exactly as written.
Analyze the message. Keep every placeholder exactly as written. Do not guess real names, numbers, or secrets.
Explain the message in plain language. Keep every placeholder exactly as written.

cloud_model.description: Cloud model name for task completion. The SDK default is gemini-3.5-flash-lite.
